headline: Alibaba unveils new AI chip, plans 20GW of datacenters
summary: Alibaba is planning a six-year buildout to 20GW of datacenters and has unveiled its Zhenwu V900 AI accelerator chip, claimed to triple the performance of its predecessor with 216GB of memory as it targets a 10-trillion-parameter Qwen model. The US alone already has 37GW of datacenter capacity under construction.
